title: Prototype a redesigned Anthus homepage
description: Reimagine the Anthus homepage visual design while preserving existing copy, imagery, and fuchsia/pink/blue identity. Add automatic light and dark modes, run a local Gatsby preview, and leave all work uncommitted and unpublished per Ryan's request.
right_now_summary: The Anthus homepage redesign is being prototyped with light and dark modes in a local Gatsby preview.
